'''''The Daily Rebellion''''' was a news publication produced during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that supported the cause of a pro-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Onderon rebels/Legends|insurgent group]] that sought to restore [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] to the throne of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The rebel lead [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] was a writer for the publication.
